    Point–brick data from a count of arrows and relations #

    Let F be a finite family of relations generating the relations of the cover of a piece. For a brick V vanishing at x, the extensions of V by the simple representation at x that respect the cover are the cocycles of F (crossOK_of_cocycle), and their dimension is at least Σ_{α → x} dim V(s α) - Σ_{ρ_r ending at x} dim V(s r) (Ext.finrank_data_le). If this number is at least 2, two independent extensions give the data of Bongartz's Lemma 4 (pointBrick_of_count).

    theorem LargeIndecomposable.RayCat.pointBrick_of_count {k : Type u} [Field k] {P : Type} [CategoryTheory.Category.{0, 0} P] [CategoryTheory.Limits.HasZeroMorphisms P] [IsRayCategory P] [Fintype P] [DecidableEq P] {x₀ : P} {S : Finset (Cover x₀)} (F : FinQuiver.Ext.RelFam (pieceQuiver S) k) (hF : ∀ (r : Fin F.m), F.ρ r ∈ TwoSidedIdeal.span (relGens k S)) (hgen : relGens k S ⊆ ↑(TwoSidedIdeal.span (Set.range F.ρ))) (x : (pieceQuiver S).V) (V : Rep k (pieceQuiver S)) (finV : ∀ (i : (pieceQuiver S).V), FiniteDimensional k ↑(V.obj i)) (hVx : Subsingleton ↑(V.obj x)) (brickV : ∀ (f : V ⟶ V), ∃ (c : k), ∀ (i : (pieceQuiver S).V), ModuleCat.Hom.hom (f.app i) = c • LinearMap.id) (hV : ∃ (i : (pieceQuiver S).V), Nontrivial ↑(V.obj i)) (hsinc : ∀ (i : (pieceQuiver S).V), i ≠ x → Nontrivial ↑(V.obj i)) (hVc : RespectsCover V) (hcount : ∑ r : Fin F.m, Module.finrank k ↑(V.obj (F.s r)) * Module.finrank k ↑((Rep.pointRep x).obj (F.t r)) + 2 ≤ ∑ α : (pieceQuiver S).A, Module.finrank k ↑(V.obj ((pieceQuiver S).src α)) * Module.finrank k ↑((Rep.pointRep x).obj ((pieceQuiver S).tgt α))) :
    PointBrick S

    Point–brick data from a count. If V is a sincere brick off x, vanishing at x and respecting the cover, and a generating family of relations has Σ_r dim V(s r) dim S_x(t r) + 2 ≤ Σ_α dim V(s α) dim S_x(t α), then PointBrick holds.
